answer.market_read: We are 2nd in class (1.612 vs inextro 1.659). The gap is on the shop side: book is 197.7M (rank 8/53) against inextro's 500M and dae-yangkim's 411M, while revenue (rank 6) and buyer surplus (rank 5) are already strong. That is a margin problem, not a volume problem. A 9,192-deal count with only ~10M profit means we turn over a lot of goods at thin spreads. Big-ticket sofas and beds still carry the margin: Mate 342k/unit, Avenuel 232k, Lacloud 205k, Simmons Beautyrest 165k. The Mate sofa is now crowded (15 shops, cost surge 1.164) but still clears instantly (avg hold 0h, 46 sold in 6h), so it can take a higher ask. Avenuel and Simmons Beautyrest show the opposite pattern: stock is 5-7h old and walkaways are about 1.6-2x sales. Since most walkaways make no offer when we are not the lowest ask, a small ask cut should convert some of them while keeping 15-20% margin per unit. Several thin-competition SKUs (Riposo recliner with 2 shops, Cloud Luxe and Borneo Coco with 3, Bedrium folding mattress with 3) ran to 0-3 units with sold-out asks and no surge, so more cover should be cheap volume. Apples keep selling out (20 sold-out asks) but surge is 1.134 and margin is only 4.3k/unit, so I raise the price rather than chase volume. The 23-shop Zinus Green Tea mattress is a commodity at ~12% margin; I hold it per L5. Stars at rank 25 move slowly and are partly poisoned by totato2203-r3's blanket 1-star reviews, so I do not spend knobs on them.

moves.why: Mate sofa: surge 1.164, 15 shops, yet 0h hold and 46 sold in 6h; raise price to protect margin as cost climbs
Avenuel: oldest stock 6.7h, 40 walkaways vs 22 sold, margin ~16% of selling price leaves room for a 4% cut
Simmons Beautyrest queen: oldest 5.6h, 67 walkaways vs 41 sold, ~20% margin per unit
Zinus Ultima Lux Q: oldest 4.3h, 22 walkaways vs 3 sold, ~14% margin, only 5 shops
Ace BMA SS: surge 1.082 crosses the crowding line, 0h hold; modest raise
Apples: 20 sold-out asks but surge 1.134 and 4.3k margin; price up instead of adding perishable cover
Riposo recliner: stock 0, sold-out ask, 2 shops, no surge, 220k margin/unit
Zinus Cloud Luxe Q: stock 0, 2 sold-out asks, 3 shops, no surge
Borneo Coco LED bed: stock 0, sold-out ask, 3 shops, no surge
Bedrium folding mattress: 78 sold in 6h, stock down to 3, 3 shops, no surge; cover is the binding limit

lessons.text: Cover raises on SKUs at 0 stock depend on thin supply windows; predict sold_next_6h at about 40-60% of the last 6h, not 70-85%.
lessons.why: Restocking near-monopolies is limited by market_units (often 3-6), so volume after a cover raise lags demand.

lessons.text: Book gap to the top shops (2-2.5x) is the main lever on midterm rank; prefer ask raises on fast-clearing big-ticket SKUs over volume pushes.
lessons.why: Revenue rank 6 and surplus rank 5 are already high; book rank 8 with profit ~10M on 1.58B revenue shows thin spreads.

watch.why: If Mate cost keeps climbing, margin per unit erodes; cut cover and lean on the ask
Avenuel stock piling up after the cut would mean demand is gone, not price-limited
More Riposo stock in the market means new competitors; revisit the cover raise
Wake if SungJinho or psyoung82 overtake us
